csv_project_name: Consultant for UNM Construction Cost Estimator Services
csv_agency: University of New Mexico Purchasing Department
csv_scope_of_work: The University of New Mexico ( UNM ), through UNM Facilities Design & Construction (FDC), is seeking qualified professional Construction Cost Estimating consultants to provide on-call estimating services for a variety of capital improvement, renovation, infrastructure, deferred maintenance, and new construction projects across the University system. Facilities Design & Construction manages a diverse portfolio of university capital projects and requires experienced estimating professionals capable of supporting project planning, programming, design development, and construction budgeting activities. Selected consultant(s) will provide independent construction cost estimating services to support project budgeting, scope validation, value analysis, and cost control throughout multiple phases of project development.
